contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED on the p2 Summary Page, written as a STRUCK ZERO GLYPH and read 0 under the repo's zero-glyph ruling; line 4 'Total Contributions Received (From Line 1 Column A)' carries the same struck zero, and the filer's own p4 continuation sheet prints NO contributions block at all for this period
contributions.detail: ZERO CONTRIBUTION ENTRIES EXIST FOR THIS PERIOD and that is a real absence, not an unread page. The filer's attached ledger (p3) is his cumulative sheet: its contribution column ends at the two 10/18/2010 lines that his OCTOBER report already covered, and the p4 continuation sheet — which does carry a fresh block of three EXPENDITURE lines for 11/2-11/15 — prints nothing whatever in the contribution column. A 900 dpi control crop of the contribution column across that block rendered an EMPTY area. The cover agrees: line 1 Column A and line 4 are both struck zeros, and the balance ladder closes without any contribution: 1,001.72 (line 3) + 0 (line 4) = 1,001.72 (line 5); 1,001.72 - 957.02 (line 6) = 44.70, the printed line 7 close, which the p4 sheet repeats as '11/15/2010 Remaining Balance $44.70'. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints 10,370 — unchanged from the October report, exactly as a zero period requires — and is retained as cumulative, never summed as an increment. Both the monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind conventions give 0.00 here and both close.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE ($957.02) on the p2 Summary Page, which the filer's own p4 continuation sheet prints again as 'Period Expenditures $957.02' directly beneath the three lines
expenditures.detail: 3 expenditure lines sum to 400.00 + 107.02 + 450.00 = 957.02 exactly = the p4 sheet's own printed 'Period Expenditures' = the cover's Column A. Line 6 of the balance ladder is the one cell on this filing whose glyphs are genuinely ambiguous — it renders as '957' with a raised pair that reads '72' rather than '02' — and the ARITHMETIC settles it without an escalation being able to: 1,001.72 - 957.02 = 44.70, the printed line 7, whereas 957.72 would give 44.00. Column A itself prints 957.02 cleanly, so the anchor is not in doubt; the line 6 oddity is recorded here and nothing was nudged (GOTCHAS: arithmetic closure outranks glyph reading). Column B YTD prints 10,325 on the cover and 10,325.30 on the p4 sheet = 9,368.28 + 957.02, and is retained as cumulative, never summed as an increment.

in_kind_convention: not applicable — nothing on either sheet is marked in-kind, neither the ledger nor the continuation sheet prints an in-kind column or line, and the p2 Summary Page has no separate in-kind line. Both conventions were tested rather than inherited: monetary-only gives 0.00 / 957.02 and monetary-plus-in-kind gives the identical 0.00 / 957.02, so both close on Column A.
escalation_note: One escalation, and it is the honest kind that does NOT resolve: the p2 line 6 cell ('Total Expenditures Made, From Line 2 Column A') renders as '957' with a raised pair that looks like '72' rather than '02', which is why the 2026-08-01 cover tranche listed it as unreadable. It is not re-read here as a truth claim: Column A two rows above prints 957.02 cleanly, the p4 sheet prints 'Period Expenditures $957.02', and 1,001.72 - 957.02 = 44.70 is the printed line 7 close. The arithmetic decides and the glyph oddity is recorded. Four further 900 dpi crops were the geometry proofs and the empty-contribution-column control described below.

4.measure_note: THIS PAGE IS NOT A COUNTY SCHEDULE FORM: it is the second sheet of the candidate's own TYPED LANDSCAPE ledger, a summary/continuation page carrying the October block's Period/Total figures, a dated 'Remaining Balance' line, then a FRESH BLOCK OF THREE EXPENDITURE LINES for this period, then 'Period Expenditures $957.02' / 'Total Expenditures $10,325.30' and '11/15/2010 Remaining Balance $44.70'. It has NO printed rules — rowbands.py returns 2 spurious rules — so bands were measured with the ADDENDUM A2 recovery, `rowbands.py 4 --text-lines --col 84,92`, restricted to the expenditure amount column. That returns eight text bands: 16.77 and 18.95 are the carried-forward Period/Total Expenditure figures, 20.36 (h 0.53) is the double rule beneath them, 27.31 / 29.37 / 31.37 are THE THREE DATA ROWS, and 35.43 / 37.49 are the new Period and Total Expenditure figures. `rows` holds only the three data bands, padded 0.30 either side. THIS SHEET HAS ZERO SKEW (rowbands reports 0.0 degrees, 0.00% drift), so unlike the October ledger a band does transfer across columns — but nothing needed to be transferred, since the contribution column is empty. PROOF OF EVERY ROW (there are only three), at 900 dpi: pct:83.5,27.01,9.0,1.78@p4 rendered '$400.00', pct:83.5,29.07,9.0,1.78@p4 rendered '$107.02', pct:83.5,31.07,9.0,1.84@p4 rendered '$450.00' — each the amount recorded for that row, no neighbour bleed. A fourth crop of the band below, pct:83.5,35.13,9.0,1.89@p4, rendered '$957.02', i.e. the printed period total and not a fourth entry. A fifth control crop of the CONTRIBUTION column across the same vertical span, pct:44.0,25.00,10.0,10.0@p4, rendered an EMPTY area — the evidence for the empty-schedule state on that side.

expenditures.note: the ledger's single free-text column is headed 'Expenditures' and mixes PURPOSE and PAYEE in one string with no separator convention ('Campaign Night Celebration' names no vendor at all), so vendor_raw carries the printed string verbatim and `purpose` is left unset rather than split by guesswork. This sheet's expenditure table prints NO address column, so nothing is dropped for privacy here. First row of the period block — the crop rendered '$400.00'
